description: Static self-verification and cleanup pass for the redesign preview, since the four authoritative CI checks (typecheck, lint, test, build) cannot run in this INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox (npm registry 403, no node_modules). Do a careful manual/AST-level review of the FEAT-001 changes to catch the class of errors CI would catch: unresolved imports, prop/type mismatches against the reused components' real signatures, unbalanced JSX, TanStack Router registration drift in routeTree.gen.ts, Prettier/ESLint style drift, and any accidental inclusion of inert bundle data. Fix anything found. This feature depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Re-read every file created or modified in FEAT-001 (src/routes/website-redesign-preview.tsx, src/components/redesign-preview/*, src/routeTree.gen.ts diff, any src/styles.css append). For each import, open the target module and confirm the named export exists and the props passed match the real signature (PageLayout {children, overlayHeader?}, HeroVideo {poster,mp4}, ProjectsShowcaseGrid {limit?}, content-sections exports). Confirm no default export is added to the route file and that Route is created via createFileRoute('/website-redesign-preview').

Verify routeTree.gen.ts internal consistency: the new route must be present in EVERY place the privacy-policy route is present (import, const update block, FileRoutesByFullPath, FileRoutesByTo, FileRoutesById, the three union type lists, RootRouteChildren interface, rootRouteChildren object, and the declare-module FileRoutesByPath block). A missing entry in any one of these would fail typecheck in CI. Diff against a privacy-policy grep to confirm parity.

Match code style to Prettier/ESLint config (2-space indent, double quotes, semicolons, trailing commas, import ordering consistent with neighbouring files) so CI lint passes. Confirm no unused imports/vars in the new files (eslint would flag), no `any`, and that all browser-API access is inside useEffect or typeof-guarded (SSR safety).

Confirm the preview does not weaken or touch existing tests/data: src/lib/site-data.ts, its test invariants, images.ts, package.json, package-lock.json, and existing routes must be unchanged (unless a scoped styles.css append was the only edit). Run `git diff --stat` to confirm the change surface is limited to intended files.

Confirm none of the bundle's inert data leaked into src/: no UUID asset srcs, no base64, no `onclick="{{ }}"` placeholders, no <sc-if>/<x-dc>/<helmet> custom tags, no `sc-camel-view-box` attributes. grep for these patterns across the new files and remove any that slipped in (e.g. convert any copied SVG's sc-camel-view-box to a real viewBox, or replace copied inline handlers with proper React handlers/Links).
Record in findings: the exact list of files created/changed, the confirmation that the four CI checks are deferred to CI (with the reason), and the results of the static checks above.
acceptance_criteria: Every import in the new/changed files resolves to a real exported symbol and every reused-component prop matches its real signature.
src/routeTree.gen.ts registers '/website-redesign-preview' with full parity to the existing privacy-policy/terms-of-service route entries across all interfaces, unions, and the declare-module block.
New code matches the repo's Prettier/ESLint style with no unused imports/vars and no SSR-unsafe top-level browser API usage.

The change surface is limited to: src/routes/website-redesign-preview.tsx, src/components/redesign-preview/*, src/routeTree.gen.ts, and (optionally) a scoped append to src/styles.css; site-data.ts, images.ts, package*.json, and existing routes are unchanged.
No inert bundle artifacts (UUID srcs, base64, onclick placeholders, sc-if/x-dc/helmet tags, sc-camel-view-box attrs) exist anywhere under src/.
verification: git diff --stat and git status --short show only the intended files.

grep parity check: count of 'website-redesign-preview' occurrences in routeTree.gen.ts is >= count needed to match the privacy-policy entry's placements (import + update + 3 interfaces + 3 unions + RootRouteChildren interface + object + declare-module block).
grep -rE '[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}|sc-camel-view-box|<sc-if|<x-dc|onclick=' src returns nothing in the new files.
grep confirms all four required source modules are referenced by the preview (@/components/site-shell, @/components/hero-video, @/components/projects-showcase-grid, @/components/content-sections).
NOTE recorded in findings: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` deferred to CI (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: npm 403, no node_modules).
findings: Static self-verification pass complete; no issues found, no code fixes required. FEAT-001 changes are correct as committed (e73fcfe). Files reviewed (all in scope, all part of FEAT-001 commit e73fcfe): - src/routes/website-redesign-preview.tsx - src/components/redesign-preview/preview-hero.tsx - src/components/redesign-preview/preview-metrics.tsx - src/components/redesign-preview/preview-projects-gallery.tsx - src/components/redesign-preview/preview-services.tsx - src/components/redesign-preview/preview-sections.tsx - src/routeTree.gen.ts (route registration) - src/styles.css (scoped .redesign-preview append) Imports/props verified against real signatures: PageLayout({children, overlayHeader?=false}) from @/components/site-shell (used with overlayHeader); HeroVideo({poster:string, mp4:string}) from @/components/hero-video (used with robotsPoster/robotsVideo); ProjectsShowcaseGrid({limit?:number}) from @/components/projects-showcase-grid (used with limit={6}); SectionHeading({eyebrow,title,copy?}) and TechnologyBand({reverse?=false}) from @/components/content-sections (both used correctly). Local preview-* exports (PreviewHero/PreviewMetrics/PreviewProjectsGallery/PreviewServices/PreviewValuesBand/PreviewFounderQuote/PreviewProcessBand) all resolve. All images.ts keys used exist (project-car, project-investigation, project-luxury, project-sukoon, service-ai, service-web, service-commerce, service-cloud, founder). Route created via createFileRoute('/website-redesign-preview') with head() meta title exactly "Website Redesign Preview"; no default export. routeTree.gen.ts parity: 17 occurrences of the route name, matching privacy-policy's 17, in identical structural locations (import L21, .update block with getParentRoute:()=>rootRouteImport L69-73, FileRoutesByFullPath/ByTo/ById L85/97/110, three union lists L124/136/148, RootRouteChildren interface L161, declare-module FileRoutesByPath block L229-233, rootRouteChildren object L249). No drift. Style/SSR: double quotes, semicolons, trailing commas, 2-space indent, import ordering consistent with neighbours; no unused imports/vars; no `any`; no top-level or unguarded browser-API access in any redesign-preview file or the route (grep for window/document/matchMedia/IntersectionObserver/requestAnimationFrame returned nothing). All three tags spread {...image} (width/height carried). Change surface confirmed limited via git diff --stat HEAD~1 HEAD: only the 6 preview .tsx files + routeTree.gen.ts + a purely additive (0 removed lines) scoped .redesign-preview append to styles.css. site-data.ts, images.ts, package.json, package-lock.json, and existing routes are unchanged. Bundle-artifact scan across src/: no UUID srcs, no base64, no // tags, no sc-camel-view-box attrs, no onclick= placeholders in any redesign-preview file or the route. (The one onclick= match in src/lib/error-page.ts is a pre-existing unrelated file from commit 4ed3d41, not a leaked artifact and out of scope.) CI checks deferred: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` (the four authoritative gates in .github/workflows/ci.yml) CANNOT run in this INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox (npm registry returns 403, node_modules absent and not installable). They are deferred to CI, which is the authoritative validator; this feature substituted a careful manual/AST-level static review for that gate.
